trialDefinition: One initial configuration, one B/S rule, one number of states. Replayed emitter classification is not counted a second time. Trials can share trajectories or differ only in inactive rule clauses.

exhaustiveScope.initialStates: Every seed site is state 1; all other sites are state 0.
exhaustiveScope.birthMasks: All subsets of {1,2,3,4,5,6}; B0 is excluded.
exhaustiveScope.populationStop: Stop before stepping a state whose nonzero support exceeds 600.
exhaustiveScope.boundaryStop: Stop when any nonzero cell is within the outer three coordinate rows or columns of a 512×512 axial array; there is no wrapping.

campaigns.deduplication: Complete-state normalised phase, period, translation and C; rule ignored to collapse inactive-clause variants. Full D6/orbit deduplication follows independently.

mutationGeneration.method: 1–6 cell edits within a 5×5 axial box around a randomly selected phase cell; 20% random C in 2..8; 25% one or two flips among B1..B6 and S0..S5; all surviving refractory states retained.

emitterGeneration.sourcePhases: g0..19 of the existing p30 three-way gun and p20 puffer
emitterGeneration.singleCellWindow: All 217 axial sites with hex radius <=8 about origin, substituting every other permitted state
emitterGeneration.randomMethod: 2..8 state edits within axial ±3 of a source-phase cell

emitterFollowUp.criterion: The complete state inside axial radius 12 agrees at generations 120,180,240, with equal positive support growth over both 60-generation intervals.
emitterFollowUp.conclusion: No additional distinct indefinite gun or puffer is certified by this campaign. Local recurrence and linear growth are filters, not proofs of an emitter.

limits: Exhaustiveness applies only to the stated finite input classes, bounds and stop conditions.
Failure within these bounds does not imply absence of larger, slower, refractory-seeded or B0-background gliders.
Raw recurrence record collection collapses identical normalised recurrent phases with equal C, period and translation even across rules; it is not a complete census of dynamically distinct orbits.
The five released patterns are replayed independently, compared by full phase orbit under D6, and checked against the earlier catalogue. No priority or mathematical novelty claim is made.
